description:
Determine raw-batch and dot-product crossovers and measure compatible wide polynomial operations against gf2x without conflating their semantics.

## Background

After capability-correct raw-batch dispatch is available, a full size-grid study can determine which paths actually pay. Raw independent products, dot-product accumulation and long-polynomial multiplication retain distinct comparison cells.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-02: Measure raw batches and FieldVec dot products across the frozen small/crossover/cache/streaming grid, separating packing, accumulation, extraction and reduction costs. Use the pinned current implementation and retain the bounded predicate-fix receipt as evidence rather than assuming a speedup.

- [hard] REQ-03: Compare operation-equivalent wide polynomial products against the pinned gf2x build with its observed basecase. Record raw independent-product cells without an external equivalent honestly; include composed field-reduction or representation costs where required.

- [hard] REQ-04: Commit release assembly and profiler attribution of dependencies, instruction throughput, spills and conversion overhead. Evaluate bounded unrolling or fusion experiments only when the measured profile justifies them; no instruction-width-based speedup promises.

- [hard] REQ-05: Publish qualifying selector/crossover recommendations with independent holdout measurements for the canonical tuning mechanism. Retain the established path in no-win domains; any additional production algorithm change has separately reviewed, tracked implementation scope.

## Notes

Pin exact source and build identities in the family addendum. Preserve unavailable, incompatible and losing arms rather than substituting a different operation.
title: Measure carry-less multiplication crossovers and polynomial competitiveness
